verdict.rationale: Stripe provides the core building blocks an agent would need: webhooks for real-time failed-payment events, Smart Retries and no-code revenue recovery/dunning features, an API/CLI/MCP server for programmatic and agentic access, and idempotency for safe retry actions. However, there is no documented API-driven workflow specifically for an agent to programmatically trigger or customize dunning outreach (email sequences) or configure retry schedules via API — Smart Retries/recovery are described as dashboard/no-code features rather than agent-drivable endpoints. missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for configuring/triggering dunning outreach and retry schedules, evidence of an agent actually orchestrating this end-to-end, independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow.
